definition: Customer-table records with subsidiary = 2 (Versatile High-Performance Coatings, LLC) and category NOT IN (2 Garage Experts, 14 Vendor), bucketed by TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM') (record-creation month, never first-order month). total_records = COUNT(id). with_phone = COUNT(TRIM(phone)) - NULL-safe test for a non-blank phone; in SuiteQL '' IS NULL so "TRIM(phone) <> ''" is never true. mobilephone and altphone were checked and are NULL for every record in 2025-06..2026-08, so phone is the only capture field used. with_email = COUNT(TRIM(email)). customers = records that are Customers per METHODOLOGY.md (stage LIKE 'CUSTOMER%' AND firstorderdate IS NOT NULL), measured to date at pulled_at. assigned_records = COUNT(salesrep) (salesrep NOT NULL); assigned_with_phone / assigned_with_email = the same capture tests restricted to assigned records. phone_capture_pct = with_phone/total_records*100; email_capture_pct = with_email/total_records*100; conversion_pct = customers/total_records*100; assigned_phone_capture_pct = assigned_with_phone/assigned_records*100; all rounded to 0.1. Query: src/data/queries/lead_quality.sql.
phone_fields_used: phone (mobilephone and altphone checked: NULL for all records in range)
